events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows the military strength of the US but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has significant implications for global energy markets and geopolitical stability. The US, UK, and other nations are involved, making it a complex situation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation could lead to increased volatility in energy markets, affecting oil prices and the broader economy. The US and its allies may impose sanctions, which could impact global trade and economic growth. Buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could provide a hedge against potential market downturns, while shorting the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) could profit from potential declines in oil prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US-Iran relations and oil price movements

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or oil prices stabilize

events.title: US Interest Rates

events.reasoning: If the Fed hikes interest rates, it could lead to a stronger US dollar, higher bond yields, and lower stock prices. Buying the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) could provide a hedge against potential market downturns, while shorting the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could profit from potential declines in stock prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Fed statements and inflation data

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the Fed pauses rate hikes or inflation declines

gains.extendedNote: If the Fed hikes rates aggressively
